lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jenny Andreev is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Jenny is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Jenny Andreev is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Jenny kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Jenny's gone." Owen looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Jenny." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Hilda blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Silver Tongue (Level 1). Words are tools. You've got a whole workshop.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Jenny Andreev, 41 days. The mantle passes to Hilda Campos.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Hilda Campos, 27 — a taxi driver. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Dowsing, Echo Location, Berserker Rage.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Jenny — and Jenny is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Dwayne, Jacqueline, Owen and 4 more speak for Hilda — "Jenny trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Hilda before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
